title: Semantic Elements vs ARIA: What to Use When

scenes.say: Semantic elements or ARIA? Which should you use first for accessibility?

scenes.label: HTML
scenes.sub: Elements like nav, main, button, header
scenes.say: Start with semantic HTML. Elements like nav, main, button, and header give meaning and structure out of the box.
Semantic elements are natively accessible. ARIA is for when semantics can't do the job, but needs extra care.
A button tag is accessible by default. A div with role equals button needs ARIA and keyboard support.

scenes.question: Should ARIA replace semantic HTML?
scenes.right: No. Use semantic HTML first; ARIA is for gaps only.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: Should ARIA replace semantic HTML? No. Use semantic HTML first. ARIA is only for gaps.
